text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Conquering the Nippon Derby is
<chrname>!
<chrname> has claimed the title of Japan's best!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> is so strong...!
Even down the final stretch—hey, you!
Why are you fiddling with your phone?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I'm looking into it. That "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" thing you mentioned earlier. <chrname>'s in it too, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
They say there's a 'Representative Exchange Match' next month.
And they're taking supporter sign-ups too...
............I'm definitely joining.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Talk about fast on your feet!?
Though if it means seeing <chrname> in action,
maybe it's not a bad idea~...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
(...<chrname> and the others are
steadily generating excitement.)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
(Draw in this heat and let it blaze.
That blazing wind will become a tailwind to carry me to the world.)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —Then I will too. Pour everything you can as the leader into everyone in 'Project L'Arc.'

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
First, in the upcoming Representative Exchange Match.
We'll scale it up compared to last time and draw people in.
More runners, more PR... spreading to the general public, too—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to arrange a race worthy of Team Japan
at the "Representative Exchange Race"...!

—In the winner's circle filled with joyful cheers,
I welcomed and praised <chrname>.

Let's keep going like this. To secure our ticket as Japan's representative at next month's Representative Exchange Match.
To fulfill the dream of becoming the best in the world—
